decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - 1		NON-STD	The applicant shall employ a suitably qualified person to provide ecological advice into the design and implementation of a landscape and management plan for the area around the tiled spillway.  The intent of the landscaping shall be increasing the indigenous biodiversity on the site, with the focus being the interaction between the river and the riparian area.  The landscape plan shall be submitted to the Council for approval in writing prior to the use of the proposed equipment.
description: Installation of water cooling equipment (including underground filter and pump chamber with pipework and overground stepped tiled run off utilising water pumped from and back into the river Brent canal adjacent to G S K House
